geometry.method: Actual CPU-deformed wolf head/jaw triangles against actual native-animated warrior skin triangles at the first HP damage frame. Maul target is weighted Hips/Spine/Spine1/Spine2 torso skin, not a standing proxy.

chronology.postRamSourceClock: 1x real time; cast speed affects run-up only

rigAndFeet.interpretation: Limb lengths and scales remain strict. Explicit inherited non-limb pose carriers follow authored R12 translations and the exact approved WATCH0 endpoint; they are not universally equated with bind translations.

resolvedFindings: The former standing100-damage bite is replaced by head40, genuine fall, and two prone-body jaw30 phases.

Actual surface probes rejected the original broad engagement band and early contact windows despite passing bone capsules. The visible authored weight shift, honest narrow band and calibrated windows now meet all72 matrix skin contacts.
The original neutral end pose dragged feet by up to0.382m when blending to WATCH0. Authored recovery steps now reach the actual approved watch stance; the measured seam is reported above.

Test-only cumulative fresh-asset heap pressure was removed by bounded asset reuse with real controller/animator/combat resets. Global character-profile contamination in mixed calibration/reuse was fixed by restoring warrior-plains before each bout. These are harness findings, not device/game performance measurements.
limitations: NullEngine uses replacement materials. Triangle intersection proves geometric surface overlap, not convincing impact, natural motion or material/skin quality.
Root separately reviewed the original-color coupled runtime images. This independent numeric report does not substitute for that visual review.
No browser automation was used. Device FPS, GPU cost, heat, controls and touch feel remain unmeasured.
The hitch gates validate temporal source-clipped torso contact; instantaneous skin intersections are asserted separately for all standard30/60Hz matrix and rear-hit frames.
